record.one_liner: Enterprise CRM platform with a very broad REST/SOAP/Bulk API surface.
record.auth_notes: REST API requires OAuth 2.0 via an external client app (new) or connected app (creation restricted since Spring '26); multiple flows incl. client credentials. Per search snippets; developer.salesforce.com docs returned HTTP 403 to fetch.
record.access_notes: Free Developer Edition org gives working API access (per Salesforce docs search snippet; page not fetchable).
record.api_notes: REST, SOAP, Bulk, Metadata, UI GraphQL APIs covering essentially all standard and custom objects (from prior knowledge; docs 403).
record.human_reason: developer.salesforce.com docs (OAuth, signup, hosted MCP) all returned HTTP 403; auth/access/API fields rest on search snippets and the archived salesforcecli/mcp repo (which also says EOL Nov 2 2026 in favor of hosted MCP servers).

record.one_liner: Help desk / service platform with a very broad REST API across Support, Help Center, Sell and more.
record.auth_notes: OAuth access tokens (recommended; global OAuth client for multi-customer apps); API tokens via Basic auth (email/token:token) are marked deprecated.
record.access_notes: 14-day free trial; API tokens created in Admin Center > APIs; OAuth clients created by admins. Plan requirements not stated.
record.api_notes: Ticketing, Help Center, Messaging, Voice, Custom Data, Sell CRM, Apps and more APIs.
record.human_reason: Zendesk's own MCP server status is contradictory: an opened Oct 2026 article says announced but no public docs; search results claim early access opened Nov 10 2026 (not verifiable on developer.zendesk.com). Marked community pending confirmation.

record.one_liner: Help desk platform with API v3 (key-based) and an official MCP integration.
record.auth_notes: API v3 uses an apikey parameter; MCP supports OAuth 2.1 or Bearer token (up to 10 tokens, 2-year expiry).
record.access_notes: Key created in agent panel; docs opened do not state plan requirements or trial terms (trial assumed from prior knowledge).
record.api_notes: API v3 with scoped keys; breadth not confirmed from opened pages.

record.one_liner: Chat platform with bot and OAuth2 REST API plus Gateway.
record.auth_notes: Bot token from developer portal; OAuth2 code/client-credentials grants.
record.access_notes: Create app in Developer Portal. Some scopes (dm_channels.read, voice, rpc) partner-only; privileged intents need verification at scale.

record.one_liner: Google Ads API (gRPC/REST) with official MCP server.
record.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 (service account or user flows). Developer tokens sunset Sept 9 2026 and are ignored.
record.access_notes: New Cloud project gets Test access (test accounts only); production needs Explorer/Basic/Standard access via brand verification and review (Basic automated, Standard manual).

record.one_liner: HighLevel CRM with OAuth marketplace apps and official MCP.
record.auth_notes: OAuth 2.0 auth-code via Marketplace app (agency/location tokens). Private Integration Tokens exist but fetched page was empty.
record.access_notes: Free developer account to create marketplace apps; installing/testing needs a HighLevel account/sub-account; plan requirements not stated in fetched docs.
record.api_notes: Contacts, conversations, calendars, opportunities, payments, locations etc.
record.human_reason: Plan/trial requirement for test accounts and Private Integration Token details not confirmed from primary docs.

record.auth_notes: API key as Bearer token with per-key permissions.
record.access_notes: Free plan retired (May 2025); new accounts get a trial per secondary sources; paid plans otherwise. Trial terms not on primary pages.
record.api_notes: Mail send, templates, contacts, marketing, stats, suppression.

record.one_liner: Platform for creators to sell digital products.
record.auth_notes: OAuth2 for third-party apps; personal access token generated in app settings.
record.access_notes: Create an application in account Advanced settings and generate a non-expiring access token (per search results/help center; article body not retrievable).
record.api_notes: gumroad.com/api lists OAuth2, access tokens, endpoints/resources and MCP topics; resource detail from search results (products, sales, subscribers, licenses).

record.one_liner: Scraping API with scraper, web search, workflow and residential proxy products.
record.auth_notes: API token (Bearer) from dashboard; hosted MCP supports OAuth 2.1.
record.access_notes: Sign up via Dashboard; docs do not mention free credits or trial terms.
record.api_notes: Scraper API, Web Search, Workflow API, proxy; MCP exposes seven services.

record.one_liner: GTM data enrichment/workflow platform with a Public API and hosted MCP.
record.auth_notes: Public API uses clay-api-key header; hosted MCP uses OAuth (per search results).
record.access_notes: Sources conflict on plan gating (Enterprise vs all plans); quickstart does not state plans.
record.api_notes: Public API for calling Clay from apps; endpoint list not in quickstart; structured queries need Enterprise table sync (per Clay University via search).
record.human_reason: Plan requirements for API access conflict between sources; MCP page developers.clay.com/concepts/mcp.md returned 404.

record.one_liner: Collaborative docs with tables and automations (now Superhuman Docs).
record.auth_notes: API token sent as Bearer; how to create token not on opened page.
record.access_notes: API free in free and paid workspaces; some endpoints depend on owner role.
record.api_notes: REST API: docs, pages, tables, rows, formulas, permissions, automations.
record.human_reason: Official hosted MCP (docs.superhuman.com/apis/mcp) seen only in search results; the page returned 401 so not opened.

record.one_liner: Cryptocurrency exchange with spot, futures and account APIs.
record.auth_notes: API key in X-MBX-APIKEY header; signed endpoints need timestamp+signature (HMAC-SHA256, RSA or Ed25519).
record.access_notes: Create keys in account API Management; trading permission is off by default and must be enabled. Account (KYC) required.
record.api_notes: Spot REST docs reviewed; Binance also publishes WebSocket streams and derivatives APIs (not opened in detail).

record.one_liner: Corporate cards, expense, bill pay and travel platform.
record.auth_notes: User tokens created in dashboard (Developer settings) sent as Bearer; OAuth2 supported (MCP and OpenAPI spec).
record.access_notes: Requires an existing Brex customer account; an account/card admin must accept the Developer API agreement before creating tokens.
record.api_notes: Team API (users, departments, cards, locations, etc.) plus payments, transactions, expenses, budgets.
record.blocker: requires Brex customer account + admin agreement

record.auth_notes: MCP uses OAuth; reported Enterprise-only Public API uses Bearer API keys (secondary sources).
record.access_notes: Public API reportedly Enterprise workspaces only; MCP available via user OAuth sign-in.
record.api_notes: Reported api.otter.ai/v1: conversations, channels, audio links, webhooks (unverified).
